input.goal: Create a single self-contained index.html: an interactive full-viewport HTML5 Canvas orbital particle simulation in dark space with a glassmorphism HUD, click-to-spawn particle bursts, zero external dependencies.
constraints: Single file index.html with inline <style> and <script>; no external URLs, fonts, scripts or images
Page/body background color #060913; canvas id="sim" fills the full window (position fixed, 100vw x 100vh)
Canvas backing size = window.innerWidth*devicePixelRatio by innerHeight*devicePixelRatio, ctx.setTransform(dpr,0,0,dpr,0,0); recompute on window resize
Animation loop uses requestAnimationFrame
Central star drawn with ctx.createRadialGradient, with a corona whose radius pulses subtly over time (sin of time)
At least 5 planets in window.app.planets, each with distinct orbital radius, angular speed and color
At least 3 moons total in window.app.moons, each orbiting a planet
Each planet keeps a trail array of recent positions drawn with fading alpha; trails are drawn only when app.trails is true
At least 150 background stars in window.app.stars, each twinkling (alpha varies with time)
HUD overlay div id="hud" with glassmorphism: semi-transparent background rgba, backdrop-filter: blur(...), border 1px rgba white, border-radius
Button id="playBtn" toggles app.running; its text is 'Pause' when running and 'Play' when paused
Button id="trailsBtn" toggles app.trails; its text is 'Trails: ON' or 'Trails: OFF'
Button id="resetBtn" resets app.time to 0, clears app.particles, clears planet trails, resets planet angles to initial values

Exactly: <input type="range" id="speed" min="0.2" max="3.0" step="0.1" value="1.0">; on input it sets app.speed = parseFloat(value) and updates span id="speedVal" to text like '1.0x' (value.toFixed(1)+'x')
Span id="fps" shows live FPS integer, span id="time" shows app.time in seconds with 1 decimal, span id="count" shows app.particles.length; updated at least every 250ms
app.time advances by dt*app.speed only while app.running; planets move by angular speed*dt*app.speed only while running
Clicking (mousedown/click/pointerdown) on the canvas spawns 40-80 particles at the click point into app.particles with radial velocities in all directions

Particles: velocity multiplied by a damping factor (e.g. 0.96) each frame, life decreases, alpha fades with life, drawn glowing (globalCompositeOperation 'lighter' or shadowBlur), removed when life <= 0
Expose window.app = {running, trails, speed, time, planets, moons, stars, particles} as the live state object
Valid JavaScript, no console errors

I've created `index.html`, but one browser check failed, so the Reset button isn't confirmed to work.

Tandem's local model wrote the file. Its browser test (33 steps) passed every step except the last one, the Reset check. That check ran after the speed was set to 2.5x and expected the simulation time to be under 0.2 s just after Reset was clicked. At that speed, the clock could pass 0.2 s in the short gap between the click and the check. I read the Reset code and it does reset the time and clear the bursts and trails, so the failure is probably that timing gap rather than a bug. I couldn't rerun it, because Playwright isn't installed here.

I also fixed one bug myself: each canvas click was creating three bursts instead of one, because the canvas listened for `pointerdown`, `mousedown` and `click`. It now listens only for `pointerdown`. After that change, the script still passes a JavaScript syntax check.

Opening `index.html` in a browser and clicking Reset after a few seconds would settle it.
